headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Revenue grew 10.0% YoY to INR 1,559 cr (~15% adjusted for the festive and online tower event shift) and 21.9% QoQ on the seasonally stronger quarter.
EBITDA excluding other income rose 15.5% YoY to INR 216 cr, with margin up 70 bps YoY to 13.9%.
Gross margin improved ~140 bps YoY to 53.9% on lower discounting, premiumization and a better channel mix.
PBT grew only 4.5% YoY to INR 91 cr as lower other income and higher depreciation and interest absorbed most of the EBITDA gain.
valuation: NWC stayed controlled at INR 1,088 cr (65 days), with inventory turns at ~3.4x and management targeting improvement over 12-18 months.
Valuation: We maintain a BUY rating on AFL with a target price of INR 478 based on 24.8x FY29E P/E, implying an upside of 35% from the CMP of INR 354.
The FY27 objectives remain 12-15% revenue growth and a 100-200 bps increase in direct channel share, toward a long-term target of 65%.
watch: The West Asia conflict remains a key monitorable (raw material inflation ~5-6%), and management plans to mitigate a ~5% cost increase on new-season buys with a 1.5-2% MRP increase, having taken only a marginal price increase so far.
Risks: Slower discretionary demand recovery, margin pressure from higher input costs, weaker retail consumption, and execution risks in D2C and store expansion.
